columns.meaning: GB settlement date; since v2.0.0 derived from the vendor startTime instant (fuelhh.py:135-165)
Half-hour index within the settlement date, 1..50 (46 / 50 on clock-change days; schema ge=1 le=50)
Start of the half-hour, UTC (vendor startTime)
Elexon fuel-type code, uppercase as sent (e.g. CCGT, WIND, INTFR)
Generation in MW for the period. INT* codes are signed, positive = import to GB (vault fuelhh.md:150-156). PS is also signed; its sign meaning is unknown (not defined in code or vault)
Vendor publication time (publishTime / publishDateTime coalesced, fuelhh.py:81-85)
Literal 'elexon'

Event instant used by the bitemporal layer; from the dataset's time column, else the target date (added by BaseSilverTransformer, silver/base.py:2203-2223). Not in the Pydantic class.
When the row became knowable: coalesce(published_at, ingest time) (silver/base.py:2095). Not in the Pydantic class.
Pipeline run UUID that wrote the row (lineage). Not in the Pydantic class.
Transformer DATASET_VERSION stamped on the row. Not in the Pydantic class.
